GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When qst re her riding in the middle stages, rider stated that she was able to obtain a position in the lead which is consistent with the gelding’s usual settling position. She added that during the middle stages she attempted to steady the tempo after obtaining the lead to allow for cheaper sectionals. She added that her mount resented this pressure, so rather than persisting she allowed her mount to travel where it was comfortable. She further added that she did not place her mount under full pressure until the 300m so as to preserve a finishing effort. Stewards noted explanation.
